assessment.nobel_worthiness: The Higgs discovery completed a central test of the Standard Model and stands among the defining achievements of experimental particle physics.
assessment.attribution: These leaders were instrumental in conceiving and building ATLAS and CMS, whose independent results established the discovery. Credit must reflect the enormous collaboration effort.
assessment.maturity: The signal has been confirmed across channels and studied for more than a decade; the result is exceptionally secure.
uncertainties: The appropriate individual recognition for work carried out by two very large collaborations is difficult to delimit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: WMAP's precise mapping of the cosmic microwave background made cosmology a precision science and established a remarkably successful standard model of the Universe.
assessment.attribution: Bennett and Page led key experimental and instrumental work, while Spergel played a leading role in interpreting the cosmological results. The achievement depended on a broad mission team.
assessment.maturity: Independent measurements, especially Planck, have extensively confirmed the main cosmological picture.
uncertainties: The boundary between WMAP's specific contribution and the broader sequence of CMB experiments needs careful treatment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Photonic crystals and band gaps introduced a powerful way to control light, with lasting consequences for optics and photonics.
assessment.attribution: Yablonovitch and John independently established the central concept, while Joannopoulos made foundational theoretical contributions that clarified and developed the field.
assessment.maturity: The effect is well established experimentally and has supported decades of research and applications.
uncertainties: The relative weight of the independent early proposals and the subsequent theoretical development requires careful attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantum key distribution helped establish quantum information as a physical field and showed how quantum principles can secure communication.
assessment.attribution: Bennett and Brassard introduced the first influential protocol, and Ekert independently developed an entanglement-based approach. The distinct contributions are identifiable.
assessment.maturity: The principles are experimentally mature and have motivated extensive practical development, though secure operation depends on implementation details.
uncertainties: The credited names include two forms of Ekert's name; I use the uninitialled form exactly as listed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The detection of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos opened a new observational window on the nonthermal Universe and established neutrino astronomy.
assessment.attribution: Halzen's scientific leadership and long effort to realize IceCube were central, while the measurements themselves are a major collective achievement.
assessment.maturity: The astrophysical neutrino flux is established and subsequent observations have strengthened the case, although identifying individual sources remains difficult.
uncertainties: Recognizing one person for a large detector collaboration risks understating the contributions of the wider IceCube team.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Locating gamma-ray burst afterglows and establishing the bursts' cosmological distances transformed high-energy astrophysics.
assessment.attribution: Costa and Frontera were central to the BeppoSAX observations that enabled rapid localization, and Kulkarni led key afterglow follow-up work.
assessment.maturity: The cosmological origin is firmly established, with later observations building a mature field.
uncertainties: The discovery unfolded through a chain of satellite observations and ground-based follow-up, so the decisive individual contributions need precise definition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantum error correction and fault tolerance resolved a fundamental obstacle to quantum computation and created a deep, influential body of physics.
assessment.attribution: Shor and Steane introduced pioneering error-correcting codes, while Kitaev developed influential fault-tolerant and topological approaches. Their contributions are substantial but span related advances.
assessment.maturity: The theory is well established and experimental demonstrations have progressed, while large-scale fault-tolerant operation remains an active goal.
uncertainties: The field has many important contributors beyond these foundational figures.
The ultimate physical reach of fault-tolerant quantum computing is still being demonstrated.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Inflation offers a compelling account of early-universe dynamics and the origin of primordial structure, with major influence on modern cosmology.
assessment.attribution: Guth and Linde developed influential inflationary ideas, and Mukhanov made foundational contributions to the theory of primordial perturbations. The development involved multiple models and contributors.
assessment.maturity: The framework is mature theoretically, but the inflationary mechanism has not been established by a distinctive direct observation.
uncertainties: There is no consensus on which inflationary model, if any, describes the early Universe.
A definitive primordial gravitational-wave signal has not been observed.
